s.t:
Wir handeln THG-Quoten und betreiben mit Elektrovorteil eine der aktiven B2C-Marken im Markt. Hinter dem Wachstum steht ein kleines, schnelles Team, das seine Prozesse konsequent mit KI und eigenen Tools skaliert statt mit mehr Köpfen.
Wir suchen jemanden, der genau das vorantreibt: aus einem Ticket wird bei dir in Tagen ein laufendes Tool, kein Backlog-Eintrag für nächstes Quartal. Wenn du KI nicht als Buzzword, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug nutzt und Freude daran hast, Systeme zu verbinden und Abläufe zu automatisieren, passt die Rolle.
Deine Mission
Du machst unser Unternehmen operativ schneller, indem du Prozesse automatisierst, interne Tools baust und unsere Systemlandschaft (HubSpot, Mailchimp, interne Datenbanken, KI-Assistenten) zu einem sauber verzahnten Ganzen machst.
Aufgaben
Ticket zu Vibecode: Du nimmst Anforderungen aus dem Team auf und setzt sie mit modernen KI-Coding-Tools (Claude Code, Cursor und vergleichbar) schnell in funktionierende, verlässliche Lösungen um. Prototyp heute, pilotreif diese Woche.
Prozesse automatisieren: Du findest wiederkehrende manuelle Abläufe (Support, Kampagnen, Reporting, Datenpflege) und ersetzt sie durch Automatisierungen und Skripte.
Tools bauen und betreiben: interne Web-Tools, Dashboards, kleine Services und KI-Assistenten. Von der Idee über die Umsetzung bis zum stabilen Betrieb.
HubSpot-Integration: Du verbindest HubSpot mit unseren übrigen Systemen (Datenflüsse, Workflows, Anreicherung, Reporting) und sorgst dafür, dass Vertrieb und Marketing sauberer arbeiten.
Interteam-Kommunikation: Du bist die technische Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Support und Trading. Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in Lösungen und die Lösungen zurück in verständliche Ergebnisse.
KI im Alltag verankern: Du hilfst dem Team, KI-Werkzeuge produktiv und sicher zu nutzen, und baust die dafür nötige Infrastruktur (MCP-Anbindungen, Assistenten, Vorlagen).
Qualifikation
Du baust eigenständig Software und Automatisierungen. Node.js, Python, SQL und moderne Web-Stacks sind für dich Alltag.
Du arbeitest bereits mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wann schnelles Vibecoden reicht und wann es sauberes Engineering braucht.
Du hast Erfahrung mit APIs und Integrationen, idealerweise mit HubSpot, CRM- oder Marketing-Automation-Systemen.
Du denkst vom Geschäftsergebnis her, nicht vom Feature. Du fragst zuerst, welches Problem gelöst werden soll.
Du kommunizierst klar auf Deutsch, arbeitest strukturiert und lieferst fertige Dinge, keine halben.
Nice to have: Datenschutz und DSGVO-Bewusstsein, Erfahrung mit lokalen bzw. self-hosted Lösungen, Interesse an Energie- und Mobilitätsthemen.

Echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem profitablen, wachsenden Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen direkt zur Geschäftsführung.
Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht diskutiert, sondern einsetzt. Du bekommst die Werkzeuge und das Mandat, Dinge wirklich zu verändern.
Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, geht in Tagen live und wird genutzt.
flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten, moderne Ausstattung.

We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes clusters, and applications for customers across both physical and public cloud estates. Automation for us is a software engineering problem that we approach with a scientific mindset to bring operations at scale, driven by metrics and code.
Location: Globally remote role

To become a member of our team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from bare metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in operations with mission-critical services for global brand-name customers.
As a member of the team, you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure.

Confirmo is a global stablecoin-first payment platform trusted by market leaders. Originally founded in Prague in 2014, we run one of the most established crypto payment infrastructures in the industry.

We aim to have DevOps people how they were meant to be: IaC, GitOps, Infrastructure, backend development, CI/CD, Observability … the same people can handle all this. OK let’s be fair, we’ve got quite many very experienced backend engineers and we’re a bit lacking at the Infrastructure side, but as a general concept, the first sentence holds :-).

We’re building a FinTech platform that provides crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto payments to worldwide businesses. We’re building both monolithic and microservice-based applications, dealing with the history and the future of our customers. Key Responsibilities: Contribute to the design & infrastructure at AWS.

At the moment we’re operating both EC2 instances, ECS applications and K8s clusters. The known end-game is to migrate to K8s, you’d be part of that. Contribute to our CI/CD, GitOps and all other part of pipelines. Lead the evolution of our observability stack, at the moment we’re using Loki, Grafana, Prometheus, DataDog, Sentry … among others.

Developers are responsible for handling the monitoring & alerting in our apps and features, but they need to have a reliable and easy-to-use toolset for that. Build AI bots that make our life easier - many things can be automated these days and we want to let the AI and machines do a lot of hard work, not people.

The examples are: early diagnostics, support workflows, behavioral diagnostics, etc. Contribute to the backend development in Java & Typescript. Your Profile: Has switched from hand-written to AI-first way of SW, configuration and any other type of digital delivery.

Hasn’t lost control and deep understanding of what and how AI outputs should be applied to production infrastructure, pipelines, configuration management and all other aspects of reliable SW delivery. Excels with any public cloud infrastructure (ideally AWS).

Has an advanced-user understanding of PostgreSQL or any other RDBMS, administrator knowledge is a plus. Has proven experience with Linux administration. Has real world experience with IaC configuration management solutions (we’re using mainly Terraform and on a smaller scale also Ansible at the moment).

Demonstrates analytical thinking and a highly organised mind. We don’t have the capacity to micromanage, we need to rely on your abilities. Has strong ability to prioritise and choose your battles. Our technical debt needs to be deliberate and organised. Has willingness to be regularly giving (and receiving) constructive feedback.

We are following the disagree & commit principle. Do not worry if you’ve got no prior crypto experience. It’s an insanely interesting, mind-bending domain to learn and master and you’ll have a lot of fun along the way. Location : Prague or remote from the Czech Republic.

Make impact. Be human. Stay curious.
Who we are
AI is transforming the world – and we’re just getting started. With data growing exponentially, the need for smart, impact-driven minds has never been greater. At Rewire, we don’t just follow trends in Data & AI – we shape them.
If you're passionate about solving real challenges and creating tangible outcomes, then this is the perfect opportunity for you! With your innovative mindset and expertise, you're perfectly poised to help shape the future of Rewire, leveraging data and AI to develop cutting-edge solutions.
We’re on a mission to grow Rewire’s business by leaps and bounds, and we’re looking for a Cloud Engineer to help us reach our goals. In this role, you will take ownership of data & AI projects, collaborate as a peer with Cloud, Software, Data, and AI Engineers, and drive the design and delivery of production-grade cloud solutions for our clients.
You’ll build the backbone of our cloud platforms and our clients’ cloud environments by designing secure, scalable infrastructure and automating everything you touch. You’ll explore new cloud technologies, move ideas from architecture to production, and turn complex requirements into reliable systems – all while further expanding your deep cloud expertise and shaping Rewire’s technical leadership.
Be part of a dynamic team of data & AI talents who tackle meaningful challenges, build smart solutions, and have fun along the way. Wanna join the ride?

Own and architect cloud foundations that power digital transformations – design and implement the core infrastructure, platforms, and services that enable scalable products in AWS, Azure, or GCP
Collaborate across disciplines – work closely with fellow engineers, AI Experts and business transformation leaders as a technical peer to deliver production-ready cloud platforms that create real impact for our clients
Enable AI and event-driven systems at scale – design, deploy and evolve CI/CD pipelines, serverless architectures, networking, security, and the infrastructure that ML/AI workloads run on
Design and maintain high-quality, reusable infrastructure code – using Terraform, Python, and modern cloud tooling to automate everything from environments to deployments with reliability and scalability in mind
Translate architecture into business value – explain cloud decisions clearly to stakeholders so teams understand why a design matters, not just how it works
What makes us the right choice for you
Step into a role where you contribute ideas, drive innovation, and directly influence how organizations modernize their cloud, automate systems, and scale digital products
Apply and further expand your deep cloud expertise – work across AWS, Azure, and GCP, design and operate real-world infrastructures, and grow through hands-on projects and complex architectural challenges
Exchange at eye level with experienced cloud engineers – leveraging peer sparring, architectural reviews, and continuous feedback to sharpen both technical and leadership skills
Advance your own skills through GAIN® , our certified education and training portfolio, and extend your impact by sharing your knowledge and enthusiasm with others
Work alongside clients as a valued team member – building relationships based on trust, shared goals, and face-to-face collaboration whenever it matters most
Thrive in a culture that values autonomy, curiosity, and bold thinking – where your voice matters, experimentation is encouraged, and your ideas turn into impactful solutions that are recognized and rewarded
Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand
What makes you shine
You’re an experienced problem solver – with a passion for building and scaling cloud platforms that power real AI and data solutions. You’ll thrive with us if you bring:
2+ years of relevant experience in consulting, strategy, or data/AI-driven environments – showing your passion for (cloud) technology and your ability to deliver reliable, production-ready cloud infrastructure and platforms
Sharp analytical and technical skills – you excel at both problem-solving and executing solutions that bridge business and technology
Strong developer skills – Git is your standard, and writing high-quality, maintainable code is important to you
A hands-on, growth mindset – you take ownership of your work, embrace challenges, and dive confidently into new cloud technologies or complex technical problems
Driven by curiosity, collaboration, and growth – you enjoy learning, support others, and contribute to a positive, inclusive work environment

Most projects require working onsite at client locations throughout Germany (and occasionally Europe) for several days per week.

At the same time, as we continue to grow our Heidelberg office, being located within reasonable travel distance is an advantage and helps facilitate collaboration.

I move from designing architectures and trying out new approaches to building and running them in production. Alongside client projects, we also develop and refine internal cloud automations, always looking for smarter and more efficient ways to work. And best of all, I get to do this with a great group of people!" – Thomas Bennis, Senior Cloud Engineer at Rewire
Sound like your kind of team?
Perfect! If you’re up for an exciting new challenge and want to make real impact with data & AI, we’d love to hear from you.

As Principal Platform Engineer - Identity & Access Management , you will be the technical authority on authorisation (AuthZ) and authentication (AuthN) across the Kairos and Nexus platforms.

You will architect, engineer, and operate enterprise-scale identity and access solutions that secure the IFS platform while remaining frictionless for the developers and end-users who rely on them.

This is one of two Principal Platform Engineers being hired into the Identity & Access Management domain, with a strong emphasis on unifying authorisation across IFS hosting environments.

The authorisation problem is complex and high-stakes: it must work consistently across Nexus, F1, and LEC, it must scale to enterprise, multi-tenant workloads, and it is currently a blocker for NGA (Kairos) adoption.

You will work directly with the team building this today (the Authorisation subdomain under Udayanga Silva) and own the technical outcome. This is a hands-on engineering role with significant architectural scope.

You will design and implement IAM patterns that are adopted as standards across IFS , and you will work closely with platform, product, and security teams to ensure identity and access are enablers, not bottlenecks.
Architect and engineer the unified, enterprise-scale authorisation platform across Nexus, F1, and LEC, built on SpiceDB

Design and implement fine-grained authorisation models: relationship-based access control (ReBAC / Zanzibar-inspired), alongside RBAC and ABAC where appropriate
Model authorisation schemas, relationships, and permission checks that are correct, performant, and maintainable at scale
Own the operation of the authorisation engine: SpiceDB on PostgreSQL, including the migration to cloud-native Postgres (CNPG) and blue-green deployment support
Build the authorisation APIs and SDKs that product teams consume, making correct access control the path of least resistance
Architect and engineer enterprise-scale AuthN solutions, and own the implementation, configuration, and operation of identity provider infrastructure, specifically Curity and/or Keycloak

Implement and enforce OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML patterns at scale, including token lifecycle management and claims-based authorisation
Define IAM patterns, standards, and golden paths for product teams to implement securely and consistently
Integrate identity and access services with the Internal Developer Platform (IDP) to enable self-service authentication and authorisation configuration
Provide subject-matter expertise on identity and access security to product teams, architects, and security stakeholders
Maintain platform identity and access service reliability, performance, and security posture
Contribute to the broader platform engineering roadmap with an identity-and-access-first perspective

Architecting and engineering fine-grained authorisation systems at production scale , in distributed, multi-tenant environments

Hands-on production experience with a relationship-based / policy-based authorisation engine , ideally SpiceDB (or comparable Zanzibar-inspired systems such as OpenFGA, Ory Keto, or equivalent)
Deep, practical knowledge of authorisation models: relationship-based access control (ReBAC), role-based (RBAC), and attribute-based (ABAC), and knowing when to apply each
Experience designing authorisation schemas and permission models, and reasoning about correctness, latency, and consistency at scale
Familiarity with policy-as-code approaches and tooling (OPA / Rego, Cedar, or equivalent)
Understanding of the operational side: running the authorisation engine in production, backed by PostgreSQL, with observability and traceability of authorisation decisions

Architecting and engineering enterprise-scale AuthN solutions, demonstrated at production scale
Hands-on production experience with Curity and/or Keycloak : configuration, customisation, operations, and integration
Deep, practical knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, and token-based authentication patterns (JWT, opaque tokens, token introspection)
Experience with enterprise identity federation, SSO, and directory integration (LDAP, Active Directory)

Strong hands-on engineering capability across the NGA stack, or the ability to get there fast:

Backend: Go

Messaging / Streaming: Apache Kafka / RedPanda

Data: PostgreSQL

Comfortable operating in a cloud-native environment: Kubernetes (AKS), containers, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code
Event-driven and distributed systems architecture
Secure coding practices and security-by-design principles

Fin is an AI company that builds from the GPU all the way up to a user agent that resolves millions of customer service queries a month.

Help Us Change the Way the World Works
Build something that matters.
Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations.

Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

Platform Engineers at Langdock work on shared backend systems that many product features depend on. This includes the AI engine, queues, document processing, integrations, code execution, authentication, and billing.
The job is to make these systems reliable and understandable enough that other engineers can build on them. That means designing clear APIs, choosing the right data models, handling failure cases, writing tests for important invariants, adding useful observability, and keeping abstractions simple enough to maintain.
Typical problems include deciding which parts of a long conversation to keep in context, retrying background jobs without running the same side effect twice, handling model-provider failures during streaming responses, refreshing integration tokens before they expire, and enforcing tenant boundaries in shared services.

s.h: Examples of the kind of systems Platform Engineers own
s.t:
The AI engine at the core of the platform. It handles the prompts users send through Langdock and abstracts over providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Bedrock, Mistral, and open-source models. The work includes prompt caching, routing, failover across model deployments, and normalizing provider-specific behavior behind a stable internal interface.
The workflow runtime. Workflows need to execute reliably across agent steps, conditions, loops, structured-output extraction, human-in-the-loop pauses, and actions across hundreds of integrations. The platform work is about making that execution model predictable, observable, and safe to extend.
Context-window optimization. Long conversations, uploaded files, and tool calls need to stay correct while model costs stay under control. This is one of the most cost-sensitive parts of the platform.
A code execution service for running untrusted customer code. Today this means JavaScript in some places, but the direction includes broader execution environments such as Bash. The hard part is clear isolation: secrets, filesystem access, outbound network access, and tenant boundaries need to be controlled explicitly.
A flexible integration layer for connecting Langdock to external services. Most integrations are standard REST APIs, but the platform also needs to support industry standards for tools and agents, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
You will pick up a platform area over time and can shape where it goes next.
Tech stack
TypeScript across a Turborepo monorepo
Next.js, React, and Tailwind on the front end
Node.js services and workers on the back end
PostgreSQL with Prisma; Redis with BullMQ
A multi-provider model abstraction across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, Bedrock, Mistral, and open-source models
Sandboxed Node.js for code execution
Multi-cloud storage abstraction over AWS S3, Azure File Share, and GCS
Terraform for infrastructure orchestration
Kubernetes for workloads that need portable deployment across cloud providers
Linear for ticket management
Datadog and Sentry for observability
You should be familiar with most of this. We trust you to pick up the rest quickly.
How we ship
Small temporary squads of 2 to 3 engineers around a topic. Squads form, ship, and dissolve.
Every change is linked to a Linear ticket and ships via PR. CI runs lint, tests, and AI review.
We deploy continuously to production.
We use AI tools heavily in engineering. You have freedom in the tools to use (eg. Cursor, Claude, Codex). We are building a strong harness that allows engineers to move fast while shipping high quality software.
We are building a strong operating system around AI-assisted shipping: clear ticket context, focused branches, AI review before human review, explicit rollout notes for risky changes, and production verification after release.
The engineer who ships a change owns it in production. If something breaks, you lead the fix.

Habit of adding metrics, traces, and structured logs because you have been on call before and know you will need them.

Heavy user of AI tooling in your own development workflow, with opinions on what works and what does not. We are looking for people who are already compounding their output with AI.
You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

As a Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II , your charter is to build out theAgentic Platform at Porch Group — the shared foundation every team builds AI on. You will own how we build retrieval pipelines, deploy and manage remote agents, create MCP servers, route and govern model access, and evaluate all of it. When a new use case arrives, this team builds the scaffolding and often a proof of concept, then hands off to the feature team that owns the production system.
AI adoption here has moved fast: agentic coding tools are in active rollout across multiple business units, autonomous agents already open merge requests against production repositories, and a centralized LLM gateway is live.

s.h: What You Will Do As A Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II
s.t:
Build out the Agentic Platform as a product for internal teams — find what teams keep rebuilding and turn it into a paved path with sane defaults.

· Design, build, and operate internal MCP servers, and own the standards for them: auth (OAuth 2.1), tool and schema design, versioning, and testing — plus the scaffolding, templates, and registry that make creating one a solved problem.

· Build the platform layer for remote agents: how an agent gets deployed, scheduled, credentialed, observed, rate-limited, and safely retired, across conversational, scheduled, and event-triggered shapes.

· Build the guardrails that make autonomous agents trustworthy — scoped permissions, human-in-the-loop approval gates, sandboxed execution, audit logging, spend controls, and hard blast-radius limits.

· Serve as technical lead for retrieval-augmented generation — shared patterns for ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval; vector stores; incremental sync; and retrieval quality owned as a measured discipline rather than a guess.

· Own evaluation and observability for AI systems — eval harnesses, golden datasets built from the questions people actually ask and calibrated against domain experts, prompt versioning, and instrumentation through Opik, Datadog, and OpenTelemetry.

· Advance the agentic developer experience — the internal plugin and skills library encoding Porch conventions, our code review agents, the autonomous bug and security remediation agents, and tooling that makes fleet-wide migration across dozens of JVM repositories tractable.

· Extend and operate the LLM gateway (Portkey) — provider and model coverage, routing, secure access for business units outside the core Agentic Platform, and governance including access controls, PII monitoring, and cost attribution.

· Build reference implementations and proofs of concept that establish a pattern, then hand off cleanly to the team that will own it in production.

· Set standards and playbooks, mentor engineers across business units adopting AI tooling, give leadership straight answers on build versus buy, and participate in an on-call rotation for Agentic Platform services.

Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) at Braze are responsible for keeping all internal-facing services and platforms running smoothly, ensuring consistent system reliability and maximum infrastructure uptime.

SREs blend the roles of sensible system administrators and software engineers, applying sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature automation to our production environments.

We specialize in distributed systems, operating at an extraordinary scale that includes serving over 3.3 billion monthly active users, collecting hundreds of billions of data points each month, and delivering billions of messages to our customers' end-users daily.
This Senior SRE role is specifically focused on supporting the Braze Ruby on Rails monolith and our growing fleet of Go API services. This position is embedded with product engineering teams who own APIs, taking their high-level feature requirements and helping translate them into reliable, highly scalable technology stacks.

You will be responsible for the ingress fleets and API ingestion layers which serve as the main entry point for how the entire internet talks to Braze. Because of the highly operational and foundational nature of these ingress fleets, a deep, hands-on experience of both NGINX and Kubernetes is important.

Lead NGINX & Kubernetes Ingress Infrastructure
Architect and Operate Ingress Fleets: Configure, tune, and operate Braze's high-performance NGINX routing, proxying, and ingress controller layers that manage massive, real-time API ingestion traffic
Own and Expand Scaling Routines: Own, expand, and tune automated scaling routines for our high-throughput, API-based services, leveraging RED (Request, Error, Duration) metrics, Horizontal Pod Autoscalers (HPA), and customized scaling policies to ensure seamless traffic handling under extreme spikes
Partner with Product Teams on Resilient Architectures
Translate Product Requirements: Partner directly with product engineering teams owning API features to translate product requirements into resilient, highly available, and scalable technology stacks

Systems Design & Capacity Planning: Conduct in-depth systems design, bottleneck profiling, and capacity planning to ensure Braze meets its strict enterprise-grade SLAs
Incident Response & On-Call Excellence
Proactive On-Call Rotation: Participate in a PagerDuty on-call rotation, utilizing shifts not just to resolve structural alerts, but to update runbooks and proactively prevent incidents from recurring
Blameless Retrospectives: Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and blameless retrospectives for availability and performance incidents, translating operational learnings into permanent system improvements

Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience as a DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineer in a high-scale production environment

Kubernetes Orchestration: In-depth, hands-on proficiency with Kubernetes administration, cluster networking, container orchestration, cluster scheduling, and container deployment
Linux Fundamentals: Excellent, OS-level understanding of Linux/Unix internals, including disk I/O, memory allocation, TCP/IP networking, and process management
Programming Proficiency: Strong programming/scripting skills—Ruby and/or Go preferred (or equivalent languages like Python, Java) to build custom automated tools, scripting, and platform frameworks
Infrastructure as Code: Experience managing infrastructure using IaC technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or similar frameworks

→ Votre mission
En tant que Senior DevOps & SRE / Lead Infrastructure , vous occupez un rôle pivot à la croisée de l'ingénierie produit, de la gestion du Run et du conseil d'expertise technique :
Proximité Produit : Vous travaillez en lien direct et étroit avec les équipes produits (Lead Engineers, Software Architects, R&D) pour industrialiser, déployer et faire évoluer la suite logicielle ILLUIN.
Run SaaS (SRE) : Vous êtes le/la garant(e) de la haute disponibilité, de la sécurité et de la scalabilité de l'ensemble de nos services hébergés en SaaS.
Consulting Client : Vous intervenez directement auprès de nos clients grands comptes dans le cadre de missions d'expertise et de conseil (prestations facturées) pour concevoir et paramétrer des architectures Cloud/MLOps adaptées à leurs environnements complexes.
→ Vos responsabilités
🚀 1. Industrialisation & déploiement des produits ILLUIN
Industrialiser, automatiser et standardiser le déploiement et le packaging des produits ILLUIN : Doc Automation, Dialogue, nAIxt et briques LLM/NLP .
Définir et faire évoluer les stratégies de déploiement : SaaS, On-Premise, Cloud souverain et environnements hybrides .
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Software Engineering et R&D afin d'intégrer les exigences d'exploitabilité dès la conception.
Définir et faire évoluer les bonnes pratiques de CI/CD, GitOps et Infrastructure-as-Code .
Identifier et piloter des chantiers d'amélioration des pratiques Ops.
☁️ 2. Cloud & Infrastructure
Concevoir, déployer et maintenir des infrastructures Cloud via Terraform et/ou Pulumi .
Travailler sur des environnements AWS, GCP, Azure et OVHcloud .
Administrer et faire évoluer des clusters Kubernetes , ainsi que les problématiques de réseau, stockage, sécurité et haute disponibilité.
Participer à la conception d'architectures Cloud, On-Premise et hybrides adaptées aux contraintes techniques et de sécurité de nos clients.
Contribuer à la mise en œuvre d'infrastructures répondant aux exigences de sécurité, RGPD et souveraineté des données .
⚡ 3. SRE & Run
Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la résilience des plateformes SaaS.
Participer au Maintien en Condition Opérationnelle (MCO) et à l'amélioration continue des environnements de production.
Mettre en place et faire évoluer les pratiques d' observabilité : métriques, logs, alerting et monitoring.
Travailler notamment avec des outils tels que Prometheus, Grafana, ELK ou Datadog .
Participer à la gestion des incidents critiques, aux analyses post-mortem et à la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives.
Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLA et des standards de fiabilité.
🤝 4. Expertise technique & accompagnement client
Intervenir ponctuellement auprès de clients grands comptes sur des problématiques Cloud, SRE et infrastructure.
Analyser leurs environnements et contraintes afin de proposer des architectures adaptées.
Accompagner les équipes techniques clientes dans le déploiement, le paramétrage et l'adoption des solutions ILLUIN.
Apporter votre expertise technique lors des phases de cadrage et d'avant-vente , notamment dans le cadre de réponses à des appels d'offres.
Être capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.

Bonne maîtrise des pratiques CI/CD, GitOps et automatisation .
Expérience des problématiques de production, haute disponibilité, observabilité et incident management .
Connaissance d'outils de monitoring et observabilité tels que Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog ou ELK .
Bonne compréhension des architectures distribuées et des environnements microservices.
Des connaissances en Python, Java ou Node.js sont appréciées pour comprendre et accompagner les environnements applicatifs.
Une sensibilité aux problématiques IA, LLM, MLOps/LLMOps et Vector Databases est un plus.

eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.
We are looking for a Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and build and operate the scalable, secure cloud platform that connects users with our trapped-ion quantum computers.

You will join our Quantum firmware Team as a Cloud Engineer. You will build the layer through which the world reaches our quantum computers. Users submit quantum programs; your services compile, schedule, and dispatch them to our machines and return the results:
Build and operate the cloud services that let users submit quantum programs to our systems and retrieve their results.
Develop and deploy our compilation pipeline as a scalable cloud service , from circuit input through transpilation down to hardware-level instructions
Design and maintain the public API and SDK entry points to our platform
Implement job queuing, scheduling, and dispatch towards the hardware backends, including quota, prioritisation, and result handling
Own authentication and authorisation across the platform: user and tenant identity, API keys and tokens, and role-based access to machines, jobs, and results, built on an established identity provider rather than from scratch
Guarantee tenant isolation, so that quantum programs and results are never visible across customer boundaries, and manage secrets and credentials across the stack
Work with the quantum firmware and hardware teams on the interfaces between cloud services and the machine itself
Instrument the platform for observability and keep an eye on latency, throughput, and cost

Secure engineering habits: least privilege by default, proper secrets management, and awareness of dependency and container supply-chain risks

Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); German is an advantage for working with public-sector partners

Running an identity provider in production (Keycloak, Zitadel, Ory, Authentik, or a managed IAM service)
Multi-tenant isolation patterns in SaaS platforms

Improve platform reliability, scalability and performance through capacity planning, autoscaling and resource optimisation
Build and maintain disaster recovery, backup and failover strategies
Strengthen infrastructure security across areas including network policies, secrets management and platform hardening
Establish and improve incident response processes, on-call practices, runbooks and blameless post-mortems

Support infrastructure for data pipelines and AI/ML model deployment as our technology continues to evolve
Partner directly with developers on deployment, troubleshooting and infrastructure best practices.

Experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions
Strong experience with containers and Docker
Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and observability within production environments
Good knowledge of infrastructure security, including network segmentation, encryption, secrets management and audit logging
Experience building automation and tooling using Python, Go, Bash or TypeScript
Strong troubleshooting skills and experience taking ownership of production infrastructure and incidents

About Pelico
Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer , you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.
Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

Build deployment platforms that work everywhere . Design and improve Pelico's deployment architecture across Kubernetes, Docker, single VM, air-gapped environments and private cloud using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.
Create a true one-click deployment experience . Standardize installation, upgrades and operational tooling so enterprise customers can deploy Pelico reliably with minimal manual intervention.
Improve platform reliability and observability . Build monitoring, diagnostics, self-remediation capabilities and operational runbooks that allow customer IT teams to operate Pelico independently.
Participate in production operations. Join the team's on-call rotation, troubleshoot production incidents, and continuously improve platform reliability through operational excellence and automation.
Elevate our DevOps platform . Standardize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure practices and deployment workflows to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability across the company.
Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth . Contribute to initiatives around GovCloud, FedRAMP readiness and deployments for highly regulated aerospace and defense customers.
Drive AI-powered infrastructure engineering . Explore agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment, diagnostics and security.
